params.sql:
with im as (select product_id, count(*) n from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.item_master` group by product_id),
s as (
 select product_id, line_total r from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.d2c_orders` where coalesce(is_deleted,false)=false and order_date_key >= '2026-08-01' and order_date_key < '2026-09-01'
 union all select product_id, units*unit_price-promo_discount from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.platform_orders` where coalesce(is_deleted,false)=false and order_date_key >= '2026-08-01' and order_date_key < '2026-09-01'
 union all select product_id, qty*selling_price from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.qcomm_orders` where coalesce(is_deleted,false)=false and order_date_key >= '2026-08-01' and order_date_key < '2026-09-01'
 union all select product_id, net_amount from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.offline_orders` where coalesce(is_deleted,false)=false and order_date_key >= '2026-08-01' and order_date_key < '2026-09-01'
 union all select product_id, qty*unit_price_usd*83 from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.international_orders` where coalesce(is_deleted,false)=false and order_date_key >= '2026-08-01' and order_date_key < '2026-09-01'
 union all select product_id, amount from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.cafe_sales` where coalesce(is_deleted,false)=false and order_date_key >= '2026-08-01' and order_date_key < '2026-09-01'
)
select count(*) lines, sum(r) total_rev,
 countif(im.product_id is null) unmatched_lines, sum(if(im.product_id is null, r, 0)) unmatched_rev,
 (select max(n) from im) max_dup
from s left join im on s.product_id = im.product_id
